stories.headline: Kast finalizes cabinet appointments with emphasis on independent technocrats
stories.summary: President-elect José Antonio Kast completed his cabinet formation with a pro-business cast of ministers emphasizing technocratic expertise over political party representation. Analysis highlights the cabinet's board-of-directors approach to governance.

articles.title: Kast's Cabinet Set to Confront Distinctly Political Challenges

stories.headline: Kast Central America tour disrupted by flight cancellation, proceeds with Dominican Republic meetings
stories.summary: President-elect Kast's Central American tour was complicated by a canceled flight to El Salvador due to weather conditions. The trip proceeded with meetings in Dominican Republic focusing on security cooperation and migration control.

articles.title: Vuelo de Kast a El Salvador es cancelado por condiciones climáticas y reunión con Bukele queda en suspenso

stories.headline: Codelco raises $1.25 billion through oversubscribed bond sale
stories.summary: State copper company Codelco completed a successful $1.25 billion two-part dollar bond sale with record oversubscription. Proceeds will fund the company's long-term investment program aimed at extending mine life for 50 years.

stories.headline: Codelco-SQM lithium merger finalized after Supreme Court rejects Chinese appeal
stories.summary: The merger between state copper company Codelco and SQM's lithium unit reached full completion after Chile's Supreme Court rejected an appeal by Chinese shareholder Tianqi. The deal allows joint lithium production in the Atacama salt flat.

stories.summary: The 'Belarusian plot' corruption case involving Codelco advanced with testimony from Aldo Cornejo about warning Codelco president Máximo Pacheco of unfavorable court rulings. The case involves allegations of leaked judicial decisions affecting the state copper company.

stories.headline: Right-wing parties offer parliamentary pact excluding Communist Party and Frente Amplio
stories.summary: Center-right and far-right parties proposed a Chamber of Deputies agreement with DC, PS, and PPD that would exclude the Communist Party and Frente Amplio from key positions. The proposal aims to distribute power quotas among participating parties for the four-year legislative term.

articles.title: Tentación parlamentaria: derecha ofrece a la DC, al PS y al PPD pacto en la Cámara que excluya al PC y al Frente Amplio

stories.headline: Economists criticize Boric government's final fiscal balance as 'disastrous'
stories.summary: Economic experts harshly criticized the Boric government's final fiscal performance, noting it will miss structural balance targets for a third consecutive year. Economists warned about the loss of fiscal framework credibility and the challenging inheritance for the incoming Kast administration.

articles.title: "Muy mala noticia" para Kast: Último balance fiscal del Gobierno de Boric provoca duras críticas de economistas

stories.headline: Chilean military strengthens international cooperation through joint training programs
stories.summary: Chilean Armed Forces expanded international cooperation with multiple training initiatives, including Chilean Navy courses with Argentine, South Korean, and US officers, and Chilean Army officers training with the Air Force. US Army South also recognized a Chilean general for regional interoperability leadership.

articles.title: El US Army South distingue al general Valdivia del Ejército de Chile por liderar la interoperabilidad regional

stories.headline: Codelco president Pacheco expects to meet with Kast before mandate ends
stories.summary: Codelco president Máximo Pacheco, whose mandate ends May 26, expressed expectation of meeting with president-elect Kast before leaving office. Pacheco highlighted the company's current strong state and avoided controversy with the incoming administration.

articles.title: Máximo Pacheco: "Sé que el presidente electo tiene mucho aprecio y reconocimiento al trabajo que yo he hecho"

stories.headline: Court revokes Boric's dismissal in corruption investigation
stories.summary: Santiago Appeals Court overturned the definitive dismissal that had favored President Boric in a case involving alleged misappropriation of public funds, reopening the investigation pushed by Fundación Fuerza Ciudadana.

articles.title: Corte de Apelaciones de Santiago revoca sobreseimiento de Gabriel Boric en causa por presunta malversación

stories.headline: Kast participates prominently in Panama economic forum
stories.summary: President-elect Kast and a large Chilean delegation took a leading role at the International Economic Forum for Latin America and the Caribbean 2026 in Panama, described as the 'Latin American Davos.' Kast demonstrated his 'statesman side' according to coverage.

articles.title: Kast muestra su lado estadista: él y su equipo económico asumen protagonismo en el "Davos Latino"
